proposal.ruling_text: Verification was correctly returned because the recorded pre-marker forge read found the `doctor` check concluded failure. The counsel-time forge snapshot has no checks for the later marker SHA, so it is unknown—not evidence that the recorded failure became green. A returned review spends the build budget: let drive start the next build attempt and hand it the recorded doctor rejection. The supplied failing-check log could not be read because the forge was unreachable, so this ruling does not infer or prescribe the underlying doctor fix.
